description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for managing 'Note' entities in a Room database within an Android application. It includes methods for inserting, updating, deleting, and querying notes, with various search and filter capabilities tailored for the application's note management features.

classes.name: NoteDao
classes.description: Interface defining database operations for 'Note' entities, including CRUD operations, complex queries for searching notes based on various filters, and synchronization support methods.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Inserts a new Note into the database and returns its generated ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing Note, replacing it on conflict.

methods.name: getNoteById$
methods.description: Returns a LiveData-wrapped Note for observing changes by note ID.

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Retrieves a Note synchronously by its ID.

methods.name: getNoteByRemoteId
methods.description: Fetches a Note by its remote ID.

methods.name: getRemoteId
methods.description: Retrieves the remote ID associated with a local note ID.

methods.name: count$
methods.description: Returns a LiveData count of notes for a specific account.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the count of notes for a specific account.

methods.name: countFavorites$
methods.description: Returns a LiveData count of favorite notes for an account.

methods.name: countFavorites
methods.description: Returns the count of favorite notes for an account.

methods.name: searchRecentByModified$
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of notes matching a search query, ordered by recent modification.

methods.name: searchRecentByModified
methods.description: Searches for notes by query, ordered by recent modification.

methods.name: searchRecentLexicographically$
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of notes matching a query, ordered lexicographically by title.

methods.name: searchRecentLexicographically
methods.description: Searches for notes by query, ordered lexicographically.

methods.name: searchFavoritesByModified$
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of favorite notes matching a query, ordered by modification date.

methods.name: searchFavoritesByModified
methods.description: Searches favorite notes by query, ordered by modification date.

methods.name: searchFavoritesLexicographically$
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of favorite notes matching a query, ordered lexicographically.

methods.name: searchFavoritesLexicographically
methods.description: Searches favorite notes by query, ordered lexicographically.

methods.name: searchUncategorizedByModified$
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of uncategorized notes matching a query, ordered by modification date.

methods.name: searchUncategorizedByModified
methods.description: Searches uncategorized notes by query, ordered by modification date.

methods.name: searchUncategorizedLexicographically$
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of uncategorized notes matching a query, ordered lexicographically.

methods.name: searchUncategorizedLexicographically
methods.description: Searches uncategorized notes by query, ordered lexicographically.

methods.name: searchCategoryByModified$
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of notes in a specific category matching a query, ordered by category and modification date.

methods.name: searchCategoryByModified
methods.description: Searches notes in a specific category by query, ordered by category and modification date.

methods.name: searchCategoryLexicographically$
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of notes in a specific category matching a query, ordered lexicographically.

methods.name: searchCategoryLexicographically
methods.description: Searches notes in a specific category by query, ordered lexicographically.

methods.name: deleteByNoteId
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID if it matches the specified database status.

methods.name: updateScrollY
methods.description: Updates the scrollY position of a note.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a note.

methods.name: updateCategory
methods.description: Updates the category of a note.

methods.name: getRemoteIds
methods.description: Retrieves remote IDs of all non-deleted notes for an account.

methods.name: getRemoteIdAndId
methods.description: Retrieves list of notes with their local ID and remote ID where remote ID is not null.

methods.name: getLocalIdByRemoteId
methods.description: Finds local note ID by remote ID.

methods.name: getLocalModifiedNotes
methods.description: Returns notes modified locally.

methods.name: getRecentNotes
methods.description: Returns the most recent notes for an account.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a note.

methods.name: updateRemoteId
methods.description: Updates the remote ID of a note.

methods.name: updateIfNotModifiedLocallyDuringSync
methods.description: Updates a note during sync only if it was not modified locally during the sync process.

methods.name: updateIfNotModifiedLocallyAndAnyRemoteColumnHasChanged
methods.description: Updates a note if remote columns have changed and it was not modified locally.

methods.name: getCategories$
methods.description: Returns categories with note counts for an account.

methods.name: searchCategories$
methods.description: Searches categories with note counts based on a search term.

methods.name: countUnsynchronizedNotes
methods.description: Counts notes that are not synchronized.
